tasks.gr12-literature-revision-synthesis-t3: Topic: Grade 12 English HL literature revision and synthesis for prelims. Cover essay planning, contextual response, quotation revision, theme synthesis, character insight and whole-text recall. Ask learners to select best supporting evidence, combine ideas across scenes or chapters, identify strong essay plans and evaluate which quotations best support a theme-based argument.
tasks.gr12-advanced-writing-editing-t3: Topic: Grade 12 English HL advanced writing and editing. Cover transactional precision, paragraph cohesion, style, register, proofreading and common exam errors in essays and transactional texts. Ask learners to improve weak paragraphs, identify register mismatches, correct editing traps and choose linking devices or sentence structures that improve coherence and accuracy.
tasks.gr12-oral-trial-preparation-t3: Topic: Grade 12 English HL oral completion and trial preparation. Cover oral portfolio requirements, prepared and unprepared speaking, listening tasks, confidence, delivery and mixed-paper exam strategy before trials. Ask learners to identify qualities of strong oral delivery, choose useful note-making methods, interpret listening-task demands and apply practical trial-exam planning strategies.
